Title: Diiyeghan naii Taii Tr'eedaa (We Will Walk the Trail of our Ancestors)
Writer: James C. Johnson III, Princess Daazhraii Johnson
Actors: Alisha Diinashii Carlson, Gracie Carlson, Ryler Carlson
Plot: A Gwich'in grandfather teaches his granddaughter how reciprocity is embedded in our lives. The northern lights warm the caribou; they feed and sustain us; we honor the connections, bringing new meaning and wishes for the next gene...
